sql: WITH persons AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT PID,MAX(CASE WHEN Gender='Male' OR Gender='None' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) known_bad,MAX(CASE WHEN Gender IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) unknown,MAX(CASE WHEN Gender='Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) female FROM Person GROUP BY PID),c AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT DISTINCT MID,TRIM(PID) pid FROM M_Cast),flags AS (SELECT c.MID,COUNT(*) n,MAX(COALESCE(p.known_bad,0)) bad,MAX(CASE WHEN p.PID IS NULL OR p.unknown=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) unknown,MAX(COALESCE(p.female,0)) female FROM c LEFT JOIN persons p ON p.PID=c.pid GROUP BY c.MID),mf AS(SELECT m.MID,m.title,CAST(substr(m.year,-4) AS INTEGER) year,f.* FROM Movie m JOIN flags f ON f.MID=m.MID) SELECT year,COUNT(*) total_movies,100.0*SUM(bad=0)/COUNT(*) ignored_null_percentage,100.0*SUM(bad=0 AND unknown=0)/COUNT(*) explicit_female_percentage FROM mf GROUP BY year ORDER BY year
